meta.name: Cassandra
meta.description: A family moves into a vintage smart home and discovers that it's under the control of a virtual assistant — who will stop at nothing to keep them there.

videos.title: A Fresh Start
videos.overview: Samira moves her family into a 1970s smart home. Her curiosity turns into suspicion when her son reactivates the house's long-dormant AI assistant.

videos.title: Who Am I
videos.overview: Cassandra begins to turn Samira's family against her. Fynn takes an interest in a classmate. In 1971, a woman suspects her husband of infidelity.

videos.title: Endgame
videos.overview: Feeling isolated, Samira tries to convince David of Cassandra's intentions. In 1971, a mother goes to extreme lengths to protect her son.

videos.title: A Children's Game
videos.overview: Fynn goes looking for Steve. Tensions reach a boiling point during Juno's playdate. In 1964, a medical experiment takes a terrible turn.

videos.title: You Are Not Alone
videos.overview: With Samira out of the house, Cassandra takes her family hostage. In 1972, Cassandra adapts to her new living circumstances.

videos.title: Merry Christmas
videos.overview: Convinced that her family is in danger, Samira attempts to return home. Meanwhile, Cassandra asserts full control over the house.
